title: Nera Vathras - Fully Voiced Troth Dunmer Follower
tagline: Meet Nera Vathras, the fiercely independent Dunmer spellsword from Vvardenfell's rugged ashlands. Master of arcane and blade. With 273 voiced lines and SkyrimNet integration.
description:
Nera Vathras is an independent, resourceful, and spirited follower who embodies the primal strength of the ashlands she hails from.

Though Nera is aloof and guarded, her journey is one of discovery, seeking freedom as she carves a path of adventure through the rugged wilds of Skyrim. Those she travels with may find themselves protected by a compassionate, yet fiercely independent ally who balances survival with the subtle art of connection.

Nera Vathras comes with about 273 lines of dialogue from dynamic passive dialogue based on your bond to her, quest awareness, location and weather awareness, and combat dialogue. As you spend time with Nera Vathras, she'll open up more about who she is and her history, ultimately unlocking a romance with her.

You can find Nera in the The Rift, where she skillfully guides travelers through its treacherous paths, ever on the watch for chance and challenge. She'll be looking for work in The Bee and Barb or possibly Elgrim's Elixirs.
author: winterishclover
